features.name: anchor_mean_spectrum_rms_distance
features.description: RMS standardized deviation from the training-fold mean spectrum at eight anchor wavelengths spanning 401 to 1001 nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an unsupervised prototype-distance coordinate so nearby rows under the full spectrum also align on broad shape.

features.name: log_visible_signal_level_z
features.description: Log-scaled visible-band signal level centered on the training-fold average of representative visible anchors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates overall brightness while reducing dominance of raw intensity in nearest-neighbor distance.

features.name: blue_green_log_contrast
features.description: Log contrast between blue-visible shoulders near 465-477 nm and green crest bands near 541-551 nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures scale-stable color-shape differences that improve local neighborhood geometry.

features.name: green_red_normalized_contrast
features.description: Normalized contrast between the green crest and the red-region shoulder around 651-665 nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded shape-ratio coordinate that is less sensitive to multiplicative brightness shifts.

features.name: green_peak_sharpness_index
features.description: Relative prominence of the 551-563 nm crest compared with shoulders near 501 and 597 nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds local peak-shape information so neighbors match on curvature, not only absolute level.

features.name: red_falloff_slope_scaled
features.description: Scale-normalized slope from 680.9 to 720.8 nm, expressed per wavelength interval and clipped for robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes the steepness of the red-to-far-red decline, improving matching of spectra with similar tails.

features.name: far_red_tail_fraction
features.description: Fractional high-wavelength tail strength using 800-1001 nm anchors relative to visible anchors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives a bounded tail-strength coordinate that helps KNN avoid pairing rows with very different long-wavelength behavior.

features.name: oxygen_760_dip_index
features.description: Local dip index at 760.5 nm relative to shoulders at 740.4 and 780.4 nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a local-shape similarity signal around a narrow spectral trough region.

features.name: water_970_dip_index
features.description: Local dip index at 969.1 nm relative to shoulders at 951.0 and 989.3 nm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps nearest-neighbor search respect high-wavelength trough patterns that may be weak in raw Euclidean space.

features.name: bright_visible_plateau_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for an upper-tail green-visible plateau around 541-563 nm using a training-fold distribution threshold.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a simple unsupervised grouping cue so very bright plateau spectra are compared with more appropriate neighbors.

features.name: spectral_continuity_quality_score
features.description: Numeric row-level assessment from 0.0 to 1.0 of adjacent-wavelength continuity, with lower values for severe jumps, saturation, or dropout-like artifacts and higher values for smooth coherent traces.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a reliability coordinate for distance computations, reducing accidental neighbor matches caused by discontinuous traces.

features.name: profile_shape_typicality_score
features.description: Numeric row-level assessment from 0.0 to 1.0 of how closely the row follows the unsupervised training-fold spectral shape: broad 520-570 nm crest, smooth decline through 650-730 nm, and low high-wavelength tail.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an interpretable manifold coordinate that groups rows with comparable overall morphology in nearest-neighbor search.
